changes.comment: ai-assist: model alias and default refresh from provider pages fetched 2026-11-08. Moved: @anthropic:sonnet claude-sonnet-5 -> claude-sonnet-5-5 (now on the anthropic-output-format structured-output wire, since it rejects a forced tool_choice); @anthropic:haiku claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 -> claude-haiku-5-5 (adaptive thinking only, added to adaptiveThinkingModelPrefixes); @openai:flagship gpt-6-sol -> gpt-6.1-sol (added to thinkingRequiredModelPrefixes: it has no reasoning effort 'none'); @openai:nano gpt-5.4-nano -> gpt-6-luna (gpt-5.4-nano is deprecated and OpenAI names gpt-6-luna as its replacement, so nano and mini now name the same model); @google-gemini:flash-image gemini-3.1-flash-image -> gemini-nano-banana-2.1; Groq defaultModel llama-3.3-70b-versatile -> openai/gpt-oss-120b; Mistral defaultModel.base mistral-large-latest -> mistral-large-4. Unchanged: @anthropic:opus, @anthropic:fable, @openai:mini, @openai:pro, @openai:image, @openai:embedding, @google-gemini:flash, :pro, :flash-lite, :embedding, every xAI alias, Mistral embedding. New cited maxOutputTokens entries: gpt-6.1-sol 128000; gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-3.1-pro-preview 65536; Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b 65536. Capability detection gains /^claude-haiku-5-5/ (thinking) and /^gemini-nano-banana/ (image-generation). The model-name unions gain claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, gpt-6.1-sol and gemini-nano-banana-2.1. Behaviour changes for alias users: Anthropic's base tier (claude-sonnet-5-5) sends structured output as output_config.format instead of a forced tool, returns text between tool calls as progress-update thinking blocks, binds thinking blocks to the model and conversation, and cannot turn thinking off; @anthropic:haiku (claude-haiku-5-5) thinks by default, counts the same text as about 30% more tokens, and rejects a non-default temperature; @openai:flagship (gpt-6.1-sol) sends effort 'none' as 'low' (or refuses under onUnsupported 'fail') and {effort:'none', temperature} is refused before sending; @openai:nano (gpt-6-luna) rejects temperature at the provider unless effort is 'none'. Thinking off on Anthropic: a generic effort 'none' now sends thinking {type:'disabled'} to adaptive models that accept it (claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-5, claude-haiku-5-5) instead of omitting thinking, which left them thinking at the default effort; claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, the Fable and Mythos 5.x lines and claude-mythos-preview, which reject 'disabled', join thinkingRequiredModelPrefixes, so 'none' is sent as 'low' or refused; claude-mythos-5, claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 join adaptiveThinkingModelPrefixes (a budget 400s on all three). executeClientToolTurn refuses a caller-built anthropicThinkingDisabled aimed at any model that cannot run with thinking off. New IAiProviderDescriptor.samplingParamsRejectedModelPrefixes, samplingParamsAcceptedTemperature and AiAssist.rejectsSamplingParams: on the completion, streaming and client-tool paths, a non-default temperature (anything but 1) aimed at every Claude 5.x model, claude-mythos-preview, claude-opus-4-8 or claude-opus-4-7 is refused before the wire, where it was a provider 400; temperature 1, Anthropic's default, is still sent, with or without thinking (ai-assist pins anthropic-version 2023-06-01). Any temperature aimed at gpt-6-astra or gpt-6.1-sol is refused, since the GPT-6 rule has no default carve-out. New IResolvedThinkingConfig.anthropicThinkingDisabled carries a resolved 'none' to the Anthropic adapters.
